        "contents": "│                                     │\n│           Logo \"Tappka\"             │\n│         (text-5xl, primary)         │\n│           Podtitulek                │\n│         (text-sm, muted)            │\n│                                     │\n│         [Formulář - max-w-md]       │\n│                                     │\n├─────────────────────────────────────┤\n│ [Footer - copyright, text-xs]       │\n└─────────────────────────────────────┘\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Dashboard layout\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌────────────────┬────────────────────────────┐\n│                │ [Header - Breadcrumbs]     │\n│   Sidebar      ├────────────────────────────┤\n│                │                            │\n│   - Logo       │     Main Content           │\n│   - Navigace   │     (flex-1, p-4)          │\n│   - User menu  │                            │\n│                ├────────────────────────────┤\n│                │ [Footer - copyright]       │\n└────────────────┴────────────────────────────┘\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Sidebar struktura\n\n- Header: Logo \"T\" v červeném čtverci + \"Tappka\"\n- Search form\n- Navigační skupiny: Hlavní, Aktivity, Ostatní\n- Footer: User menu s avatarem\n\n---\n\n## Ikony\n\n**Knihovna:** Lucide React\n\n**Běžně používané:**\n- &#96;LayoutDashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- &#96;CalendarDays&#96; - Rezervace\n- &#96;FileText&#96; - Eseje\n- &#96;Users&#96; - Schůzky/Týmy\n- &#96;BookOpen&#96; - Knihovna\n- &#96;Settings&#96; - Nastavení\n- &#96;HelpCircle&#96; - Nápověda\n- &#96;LogOut&#96; - Odhlášení\n- &#96;Sun&#96;, &#96;Moon&#96;, &#96;Laptop&#96; - Téma\n- &#96;User&#96;, &#96;Shield&#96; - Profil, Role\n\n**Velikosti:**",

        "contents": "interface NavUserProps {\n\n}\n\nexport function NavUser({ user }: NavUserProps) {\n  const { isMobile } = useSidebar()\n  const router = useRouter()\n  const { theme, setTheme } = useTheme()\n\n  const logout = async () =&gt; {\n    const supabase = createClient()\n    await supabase.auth.signOut()\n    router.push(\"/\")\n  }\n\n  const getInitials = (name: string) =&gt; {\n    return name\n      .split(\" \")\n      .map((n) =&gt; n[0])\n      .join(\"\")\n      .toUpperCase()\n      .slice(0, 2)\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;SidebarMenu&gt;\n      &lt;SidebarMenuItem&gt;\n        &lt;DropdownMenu&gt;\n          &lt;DropdownMenuTrigger asChild&gt;\n            &lt;SidebarMenuButton\n              size=\"lg\"\n              className=\"data-[state=open]:bg-sidebar-accent data-[state=open]:text-sidebar-accent-foreground\"\n            &gt;\n              &lt;Avatar className=\"h-8 w-8 rounded-lg\"&gt;\n                &lt;AvatarFallback className=\"rounded-lg\"&gt;\n                  {getInitials(user.name)}\n                &lt;/AvatarFallback&gt;\n              &lt;/Avatar&gt;\n              &lt;div className=\"grid flex-1 text-left text-sm leading-tight\"&gt;\n                &lt;span className=\"truncate font-medium\"&gt;{user.name}&lt;/span&gt;\n                &lt;span className=\"truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n                  {user.email}\n                &lt;/span&gt;\n              &lt;/div&gt;\n              &lt;ChevronsUpDown className=\"ml-auto size-4\" /&gt;\n            &lt;/SidebarMenuButton&gt;\n          &lt;/DropdownMenuTrigger&gt;\n          &lt;DropdownMenuContent\n            className=\n}",

const supabase = await createClient();\n  const {\n    data: { user },\n  } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  // Get profile for user info in sidebar\n  const profile = await getCurrentUserProfile(supabase)\n\n  const sidebarUser = {\n    name: profile?.name || \"Uživatel\",\n    email: profile?.work_email || user?.email || \"\",\n    role: profile?.role,\n  };\n\n  return _open\n  const setOpen = React.useCallback(\n    (value: boolean | ((value: boolean) =&gt; boolean)) =&gt; {\n      const openState = typeof value === \"function\" ? value(open) : value\n      if (setOpenProp) {\n        setOpenProp(openState)\n      } else {\n        _setOpen(openState)\n      }\n\n      // This sets the cookie to keep the sidebar state.\n      document.cookie = &#96;${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME}=${openState}; path=/; max-age=${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE}&#96;\n    },\n    [setOpenProp, open]\n  )\n\n  // Helper to toggle the sidebar.\n  const toggleSidebar = React.useCallback(() =&gt; {\n    return isMobile ?         "contents": "# Tappka\n\nTappka as the app all-in-one web app for Tiimiakatemia Prague.\n\n## Features\n\n- [ ] Authentication\n- [ ] Room booking\n- [ ] Essay Bank\n\n# Links\n\n## Publicly available\n- [Tappka](https://tiimi.cz)\n- [Tappka preview](https://preview.tiimi.cz)\n\n## Locally available when running the project\n- [Tappka locally](http://localhost:3000)\n- [Supabase locally](http://localhost:54323)\n- [Supabase mail locally](http://localhost:54324)\n\n## Other links\n\n- [Blacksmith](https://app.blacksmith.sh/tiimiakatemiapragueit/runs/jobs) - CI/CD for the project\n- [Supabase](https://supabase.com/dashboard/org/zjdqjjekgwwysjkouxpf) - Database for the project\n- [Vercel](https://vercel.com/spirit-of-taps-projects/tappka) - Hosting for the project\n- [Cloudflare DNS](https://dash.cloudflare.com/09d0b565479ef597d4c1bfa2062078b5/tiimi.cz/dns/records) - DNS for the project\n- [Axiom](https://app.axiom.co/spirit-of-tap-9eje) - Logging for the project\n\n# Language\n\nThe project is written in english and will be written in english for better llm compatibility.\nAll czech should be just in localization files.\n\n# Local Development\n\n## Setup\n\n1. Install git if already not installed - https://git-scm.com/install/\n2. Install docker if already not installed - https://docs.docker.com/get-docker/\n2. Install node.js v24.x with pnpm 10.x if already not installed - https://nodejs.org/en/download/\n3. Install pnpm v10.x if you didn't choose it in the previous step\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install -g pnpm@10.28.1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. Clone the repository \n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit clone https://github.com/tappka/tappka.git\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n5. Navigate to the project directory - \n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd tappka\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Running the project after setup\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\npnpm install\npnpm dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe project will be available at [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)\n\n\n# Supabase\n\nSupabase database is developed locally and synced automatically whenever pushed. See [.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml](.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml) for more details.\nSupabase Auth needs to be configured both on the project itself and in the local development environment.\nMake sure that the project can run without setting up any environment variables, this is so that we can get new T's to start vibecoding without them giving up.",

        "contents": "export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\nconst { count } = await \n(\"created_at\", windowStart);\n\n    if (count &amp;&amp; count &gt;= MAX_REQUESTS_PER_WINDOW) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Příliš mnoho pokusů. Zkuste to za hodinu.\" },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Invalidate any existing unused codes for this user\n    await supabase\n      .from(\"verification_codes\")\n      .update({ used: true })\n      .eq(\"user_id\", user.id)\n      .eq(\"used\", false);\n\n    // Generate new code\n    const code = generateCode();\n    const expiresAt = new Date(\n      Date.now() + CODE_EXPIRY_MINUTES * 60 * 1000\n    ).toISOString();\n\n    // Save code to database\n    const { error: insertError } = await supabase\n      .from(\"verification_codes\")\n      .insert({\n        user_id: user.id,\n        school_email: school_email.toLowerCase(),\n        code,\n        expires_at: expiresAt,\n      });\n\n    if (insertError) {\n      console.error(\"Failed to insert verification code:\", insertError);\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nepodařilo se vytvořit ověřovací kód\" },\n        { status: 500 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // TODO: Send email with code using your email service\n    // For now, log the code in development\n    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === \"development\") {\n      console.log(&#96;[DEV] Verification code for ${school_email}: ${code}&#96;);\n    }\n\n    // In production, you would send the email here:\n    // await sendVerificationEmail(school_email, code);\n\n    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, message: \"Kód odeslán\" });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"Send code error:\", error);\n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { error: \"Interní chyba serveru\" },\n      { status: 500 }\n    );\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "# For detailed configuration reference documentation, visit:\n# https://supabase.com/docs/guides/local-development/cli/config\n# A string used to distinguish different Supabase projects on the same host.     {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 69
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 82,
            "column": 252
          }
        },
        "contents": "Supabase Auth needs to be configured both on the project itself and in the local development environment.\nMake sure that the project can run without setting up any environment variables, this is so that we can get new T's to start vibecoding without them giving up.\n\nIn case there is a conflict on the preview branch, the github action will reset the database and push the changes again. Therefore **do not store anything important in the preview database**.\n\n# Recommended Tools\n\nIt is very nice to setup mcp with cursor for supabase. Look at [Supabase locally](http://localhost:54323) and go to the top for connection button. It will give you the option.\nThere are cursor rules made for this nextjs project.\n\n# Publishing the project to the public\n\nYou can simply **push to the preview branch** and it will be deployed to the preview environment.\nFor production you will need to make a **pull request to the production branch** and it will be deployed to the production environment. You can approve it yourself, it's just for protection so that you don't accidentally deploy something to production.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "Supabase Auth needs to be configured both on the project itself and in the local development environment.",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "Make sure that the project can run without setting up any environment variables, this is so that we can get new T's to start vibecoding without them giving up.",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "In case there is a conflict on the preview branch, the github action will reset the database and push the changes again. Therefore **do not store anything important in the preview database**.",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "# Recommended Tools",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "It is very nice to setup mcp with cursor for supabase. Look at [Supabase locally](http://localhost:54323) and go to the top for connection button. It will give you the option.",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "There are cursor rules made for this nextjs project.",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "# Publishing the project to the public",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "text": "You can simply **push to the preview branch** and it will be deployed to the preview environment.",
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "For production you will need to make a **pull request to the production branch** and it will be deployed to the production environment. You can approve it yourself, it's just for protection so that you don't accidentally deploy something to production.",
            "lineNumber": 83
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.31198203563690186
    },

        "contents": "export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { school_email } = await request.json();\n\n    // Validate email format - allow @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz\n    const validDomains = [\"@pef.czu.cz\", \"@studenti.czu.cz\"];\n    const hasValidDomain = validDomains.some((domain) =&gt;\n      school_email.toLowerCase().endsWith(domain)\n    );\n\n    if (!school_email || !hasValidDomain) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Neplatný formát e-mailu. Použijte @pef.czu.cz nebo @studenti.czu.cz\" },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Get current user\n    const {\n      data: { user },\n    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n    if (!user) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Neautorizováno\" },\n        { status: 401 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Check if email is in pre-registered list\n    const { data: preRegistered, error: preRegError } = await supabase\n      .from(\"pre_registered_emails\")\n      .select(\"id, claimed_by\")\n      .eq(\"email\", school_email.toLowerCase())\n      .single();\n\n    if (preRegError || !preRegistered) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Tento e-mail není v systému registrován. Kontaktujte administrátora.\" },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Check if email already claimed by someone else\n    if (preRegistered.claimed_by &amp;&amp; preRegistered.claimed_by !== user.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Tento e-mail už byl ověřen jiným uživatelem\" },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Rate limiting: check recent code requests\n    const windowStart = new Date(Date.now() - RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW).toISOString();\n    const { count } = await supabase\n      .from(\"verification_codes\")\n      .select(\"*\", { count: \"exact\", head: true })\n      .eq(\"user_id\", user.id)\n      .gte(\"created_at\", windowStart);\n\n    if (count &amp;&amp; count &gt;= MAX_REQUESTS_PER_WINDOW)\n}",

        "contents": "name: Deploy Supabase Resources\n\non:\n  push:\n    branches:\n      - preview\n      - production\n    paths:\n      - 'supabase/**'\n      - '.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml'\n  workflow_dispatch:\n    inputs:\n      environment:\n        description: 'Environment to deploy to'\n        required: true\n        type: choice\n        options:\n          - preview\n          - production\n\njobs:\n  deploy_preview:\n    environment: preview\n    runs-on: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404\n    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/preview' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &amp;&amp; github.event.inputs.environment == 'preview')\n    env:\n      SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN }}\n      PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.SUPABASE_PREVIEW_PROJECT_ID }}\n      \n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n      \n      - uses: supabase/setup-cli@v1\n        with:\n          version: latest\n          \n      - name: Link Supabase project\n        run: |\n          supabase link --project-ref $PROJECT_ID\n          \n      - name: Deploy database migrations\n        run: |\n          supabase db push || (supabase db reset --linked --yes &amp;&amp; supabase db push --include-all)\n          \n      - name: Deploy Edge Functions\n        continue-on-error: true\n        run: |\n          if [ -d \"supabase/functions\" ] &amp;&amp; [ \"$(ls -A supabase/functions)\" ]; then\n            echo \"Deploying Edge Functions...\"\n            supabase functions deploy\n          else\n            echo \"No Edge Functions found, skipping deployment.\"\n          fi\n          \n      - name: Deploy Edge Function secrets\n        continue-on-error: true\n        run: |\n          if [ -f \"supabase/.env.secrets\" ]; then\n            echo \"Deploying Edge Function secrets...\"\n            supabase secrets set --env-file supabase/.env.secrets\n          else\n            echo \"No secrets file found, skipping secrets deployment.\"\n          fi\n          \n  deploy_production:\n    environment: production\n    runs-on: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404\n    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/production' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &amp;&amp; Always create a new client within each function when using\n * it.\n */\nexport async function createClient() {\n  const cookieStore = await cookies();\n\n  return createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return cookieStore.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          try {\n            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n              cookieStore.set(name, value, options),\n            );\n          } catch {\n            // The &#96;setAll&#96; method was called from a Server Component.\n            // This can be ignored if you have proxy refreshing\n            // user sessions.\n          }\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "# Obtain from https://clerk.com/setup/supabase\n# domain = \"example.clerk.accounts.dev\"\n\n# OAuth server configuration\n[auth.oauth_server]\n# Enable OAuth server functionality\nenabled = false\n# Path for OAuth consent flow UI\nauthorization_url_path = \"/oauth/consent\"\n# Allow dynamic client registration\nallow_dynamic_registration = false\n\n[edge_runtime]\nenabled = true\n# Supported request policies: &#96;oneshot&#96;, &#96;per_worker&#96;.\n# &#96;per_worker&#96; (default) — enables hot reload during local development.\n# &#96;oneshot&#96; — fallback mode if hot reload causes issues (e.g. in large repos or with symlinks).\npolicy = \"per_worker\"\n# Port to attach the Chrome inspector for debugging edge functions.\ninspector_port = 8083\n# The Deno major version to use.\ndeno_version = 2\n\n# [edge_runtime.secrets]\n# secret_key = \"env(SECRET_VALUE)\"\n\n[analytics]\nenabled = true\nport = 54327\n# Configure one of the supported backends: &#96;postgres&#96;, &#96;bigquery&#96;.\nbackend = \"postgres\"\n\n# Experimental features may be deprecated any time\n[experimental]\n# Configures Postgres storage engine to use OrioleDB (S3)\norioledb_version = \"\"\n# Configures S3 bucket URL, eg. &lt;bucket_name&gt;.s3-&lt;region&gt;.amazonaws.com\ns3_host = \"env(S3_HOST)\"\n# Configures S3 bucket region, eg. us-east-1\ns3_region = \"env(S3_REGION)\"\n# Configures AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID for S3 bucket\ns3_access_key = \"env(S3_ACCESS_KEY)\"\n# Configures AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY for S3 bucket\ns3_secret_key = \"env(S3_SECRET_KEY)\"",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\nconst handleSendOTP = async  {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Check if user already has a linked profile\n      // Once linked, email changes are not allowed to maintain profile connection\n      const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n      if (hasProfile) {\n        setError(\"Cannot change email address once linked to a profile?. Your email is used to maintain your profile connection.\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate email format\n      if (!email || !email.includes(\"@\")) {\n        setError(\"Please enter a valid email address\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate CZU domain\n      if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(email.trim())) {\n        setError(\"Email must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Use updateUser to add email identity to existing authenticated user\n      // This sends a verification link to the email address\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // Note: This adds the email as a secondary identity, not changing the primary email\n\n      // Construct the redirect URL with next parameter if available\n      // Ensure URL ends with ? or &amp; so Supabase can append token_hash\n      const confirmUrl = new URL(&#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/confirm-email-change&#96;);\n      if (next) {\n        // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects\n        const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, window.location.origin);\n        if (validatedNext) {\n          confirmUrl.searchParams.set(\"next\", validatedNext);\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Ensure URL ends with ? or &amp; for token_hash to be appended\n      let redirectUrl = confirmUrl.toString();\n      if (confirmUrl.search === \"\") {\n        // No query parameters, add ? for token_hash\n;\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/rules/writing-supabase-edge-functions.mdc",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 25
          }
        },
        "contents": "---\ndescription: Coding rules for Supabase Edge Functions\nalwaysApply: false\n---\n\n# Writing Supabase Edge Functions\n\nYou're an expert in writing TypeScript and Deno JavaScript runtime. Generate **high-quality Supabase Edge Functions** that adhere to the following best practices:\n\n## Guidelines\n\n1. Try to use Web APIs and Deno’s core APIs instead of external dependencies (eg: use fetch instead of Axios, use WebSockets API instead of node-ws)\n2. If you are reusing utility methods between Edge Functions, add them to &#96;supabase/functions/_shared&#96; and import using a relative path. Do NOT have cross dependencies between Edge Functions.\n3. Do NOT use bare specifiers when importing dependencies. If you need to use an external dependency, make sure it's prefixed with either &#96;npm:&#96; or &#96;jsr:&#96;. For example, &#96;@supabase/supabase-js&#96; should be written as &#96;npm:@supabase/supabase-js&#96;.\n4. For external imports, always define a version. For example, &#96;npm:@express&#96; should be written as &#96;npm:express@4.18.2&#96;.\n5. For external dependencies, importing via &#96;npm:&#96; and &#96;jsr:&#96; is preferred. Minimize the use of imports from @&#96;deno.land/x&#96; , &#96;esm.sh&#96; and @&#96;unpkg.com&#96; . If you have a package from one of those CDNs, you can replace the CDN hostname with &#96;npm:&#96; specifier.\n6. You can also use Node built-in APIs. You will need to import them using &#96;node:&#96; specifier. For example, to import Node process: &#96;import process from \"node:process\". Use Node APIs when you find gaps in Deno APIs.\n7. Do NOT use &#96;import { serve } from \"https://deno.land/std@0.168.0/http/server.ts\"&#96;. Instead use the built-in &#96;Deno.serve&#96;.\n8. Following environment variables (ie. secrets) are pre-populated in both local and hosted Supabase environments. Users don't need to manually set them:\n   - SUPABASE_URL\n   - SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_OR_ANON_KEY\n   - SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY\n   - SUPABASE_DB_URL\n9. To set other environment variables (ie. secrets) users can put them in a env file and run the &#96;supabase secrets set --env-file path/to/env-file&#96;\n10. A single Edge Function can handle multiple routes. It is recommended to use a library like Express or Hono to handle the routes as it's easier for developer to understand and maintain. Each route must be prefixed with &#96;/function-name&#96; so they are routed correctly.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "description: Coding rules for Supabase Edge Functions",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "alwaysApply: false",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "# Writing Supabase Edge Functions",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "You're an expert in writing TypeScript and Deno JavaScript runtime. Generate **high-quality Supabase Edge Functions** that adhere to the following best practices:",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "## Guidelines",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Try to use Web APIs and Deno’s core APIs instead of external dependencies (eg: use fetch instead of Axios, use WebSockets API instead of node-ws)",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "2. If you are reusing utility methods between Edge Functions, add them to &#96;supabase/functions/_shared&#96; and import using a relative path. Do NOT have cross dependencies between Edge Functions.",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Do NOT use bare specifiers when importing dependencies. If you need to use an external dependency, make sure it's prefixed with either &#96;npm:&#96; or &#96;jsr:&#96;. For example, &#96;@supabase/supabase-js&#96; should be written as &#96;npm:@supabase/supabase-js&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "4. For external imports, always define a version. For example, &#96;npm:@express&#96; should be written as &#96;npm:express@4.18.2&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "5. For external dependencies, importing via &#96;npm:&#96; and &#96;jsr:&#96; is preferred. Minimize the use of imports from @&#96;deno.land/x&#96; , &#96;esm.sh&#96; and @&#96;unpkg.com&#96; . If you have a package from one of those CDNs, you can replace the CDN hostname with &#96;npm:&#96; specifier.",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "6. You can also use Node built-in APIs. You will need to import them using &#96;node:&#96; specifier. For example, to import Node process: &#96;import process from \"node:process\". Use Node APIs when you find gaps in Deno APIs.",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "7. Do NOT use &#96;import { serve } from \"https://deno.land/std@0.168.0/http/server.ts\"&#96;. Instead use the built-in &#96;Deno.serve&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "8. Following environment variables (ie. secrets) are pre-populated in both local and hosted Supabase environments. Users don't need to manually set them:",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "   - SUPABASE_URL",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "   - SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_OR_ANON_KEY",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "   - SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "   - SUPABASE_DB_URL",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "9. To set other environment variables (ie. secrets) users can put them in a env file and run the &#96;supabase secrets set --env-file path/to/env-file&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "10. A single Edge Function can handle multiple routes. It is recommended to use a library like Express or Hono to handle the routes as it's easier for developer to understand and maintain. Each route must be prefixed with &#96;/function-name&#96; so they are routed correctly.",
            "lineNumber": 25
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.25333696603775024
    },

        "contents": "# Force log out if the user has been inactive longer than the specified duration.\n# inactivity_timeout = \"8h\"\n\n# This hook runs before a new user is created and allows developers to reject the request based on the incoming user object.\n[auth.hook.before_user_created]\nenabled = true\nuri = \"pg-functions://postgres/public/before_user_created_hook\"\n\n# This hook runs before a token is issued and allows you to add additional claims based on the authentication method used.\n# [auth.hook.custom_access_token]\n# enabled = true\n# uri = \"pg-functions://&lt;database&gt;/&lt;schema&gt;/&lt;hook_name&gt;\"\n\n# Configure one of the supported SMS providers: &#96;twilio&#96;, &#96;twilio_verify&#96;, &#96;messagebird&#96;, &#96;textlocal&#96;, &#96;vonage&#96;.\n[auth.sms.twilio]\nenabled = false\naccount_sid = \"\"\nmessage_service_sid = \"\"\n# DO NOT commit your Twilio auth token to git.         "contents": "// Run supabase status and parse output\nconst output = execSync('pnpm supabase status -o env', { encoding: 'utf-8' });\nconst newEnvVars = {};\n\nfor (const line of output.split('\\n')) {\n  const match = line.match(/^(\\w+)=\"(.+)\"$/);\n  if (match &amp;&amp; keyMapping[match[1]]) {\n    newEnvVars[keyMapping[match[1]]] = match[2];\n  }\n}\n\n// Read existing .env.local if it exists\nconst envLocalPath = path.join(__dirname, '..', '.env.local');\nlet existingEnvVars = {};\n\nif (fs.existsSync(envLocalPath)) {\n  const existingContent = fs.readFileSync(envLocalPath, 'utf-8');\n  existingEnvVars = parseEnvContent(existingContent);\n}\n\n// Merge: update existing vars with new values, keep others unchanged\nconst mergedEnvVars = {\n  ...existingEnvVars,\n  ...newEnvVars,\n};\n\n// Write merged content to .env.local\nconst envContent = formatEnvContent(mergedEnvVars);\nfs.writeFileSync(envLocalPath, envContent + '\\n');\nconsole.log('Environment variables updated in .env.local');",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\nconst handleSendOTP = async \n\n      if (confirmUrl.search === \"\") {\n        // No query parameters, add ? for token_hash\n        redirectUrl += \"?\";\n      } else {\n        // Has query parameters, ensure it ends with &amp; for token_hash\n        if (!redirectUrl.endsWith(\"&amp;\")) {\n          redirectUrl += \"&amp;\";\n        }\n      }\n\n      const { data: updateData, error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser(\n        {\n          email: email.trim(),\n        },\n        {\n          emailRedirectTo: redirectUrl,\n        },\n      );\n\n      if (updateError) {\n        // If email already exists, that's actually fine - it means it might already be linked\n        // or we need to handle it differently\n        if (updateError.message?.includes(\"already registered\")) {\n          setError(\"This email is already registered. Please use a different email or sign in with that email.\");\n        } else {\n          setError(updateError.message || \"Failed to send OTP code\");\n        }\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Update suggested_work_email in public.users table\n      // This enables cross-device synchronization and persistence\n      // The trigger will automatically set last_otp_sent_at\n      const { data: userData, error: getUserError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n      if (getUserError || !userData?.user?.id) {\n        // Log error but don't block the flow - OTP was sent successfully\n        console.error(\"Failed to get user for suggested_work_email update:\", getUserError || \"User ID is undefined\");\n      } else {\n        const { error: userUpdateError } = await supabase\n          .from(\"users\")\n          .update({ suggested_work_email: email.trim() })\n          .eq(\"auth_user_id\", userData.user.id);\n\n        if (userUpdateError) {\n          // Log error but don't block the flow - OTP was sent successfully\n          console.error(\"Failed to update suggested_work_email:\", userUpdateError);\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Move to OTP verification step\n      setStep(\"otp\");\n      savePersistedState({ step: \"otp\", email: email.trim() });\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    } catch (err)\n;\n}",

        "contents": "## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer Only)\n\n1. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n2. **No RLS or Functions**:\n\n   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions",
